change.runtime: entity_scripts.cpp retains file loading, reload transactions, per-entity scheduling, save hooks and public methods.
change.entity_bindings: entity_script_bindings.cpp registers the Entity userdata, pool/tween bridge and entity methods.
change.service_bindings: entity_service_bindings.cpp registers input, UI, dialogue, scene, world/prefab, camera, physics and saves, then runs the unchanged Lua self prelude.
change.internal_header: Share original state fields, service guard and entity fields/constructor/alive/live methods. Compact hidden kin::s::ScriptEntity identity keeps sol2 registry keys short.

configuration: Normal Release -O2 target flags on Clang/GCC; existing PCH on, compiler cache/LTO off, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=OFF. mold linker. sol2 safety and Lua limits unchanged.

baseline_trace.instrumentation_overhead: Diagnostic only; not mixed into timed before/after samples.

paired_compile_method: Two ABBA blocks, four observations/version. Compile stable original single-source or final three-source snapshots using matching Clang target flags/PCH, four fixed workers. Original source/final longest service source use CPU 2; final entity/runtime use CPUs 0/6. Unchanged core/json.cpp control uses CPU 4. Source/header bytes are stable throughout. This measures the entity compilation set only, without archiving/linking or ordinary project scheduling; other objects/dependencies/shaders are cached. Host activity is uncontrolled; loads and all samples are retained.
tradeoffs: Splitting exposes parallel work and smaller implementation edit scopes, but repeats frontend/template work and can increase total compiler CPU, object/COMDAT overhead and simultaneous memory. Max-child RSS is not aggregate concurrent peak memory. Do not extrapolate a parallel compilation-set gain to single-worker or clean whole-project builds.
edit_method: Three trailing-comment implementation edits of the original combined file and final runtime; one exploratory observation per final entity/service binding file. Canonical Ninja graph, four workers pinned to CPUs 0/2/4/6, through final hex_demo archive/link. Exact planned and actual C++ output sets checked. Bytes and nanosecond mtimes restored after each sample. Canonical objects recompiled from restored bytes afterward. Shared internal header edits reach all three production sources and the entity regression test; game-main implementation scope is unchanged.

runtime_probe.method: Assertions-enabled -O2 binaries linked before changing source and after the split, separately for Clang/GCC. Three processes/version/compiler in alternating order; 30 timed samples after three warmups, CPU 2. Measure an unchanged scene VM creation/control loop and 50,000 entity bridge calls per entity update sample. Assert final entity positions 330000 and 3300. These narrow probes do not establish whole-game FPS or bound every service/query operation.

limits: No clean whole-project or cumulative speedup claim; the recorded compilation set gains come from parallelism and smaller edit scopes.
No Windows/MSVC or full native desktop/3D/GPU runtime validation. Clang 3D and GCC physics/audio-disabled checks compile templates without a PCH only.
Private C++ userdata and sol registry identities change; public Lua reports and userdata layouts/traits match. This is not cross-platform ABI certification.

The original baseline dry-run initially stopped at a required CMake regeneration after creating the branch. The source was restored, the build settled, and all three recorded baseline edit samples then verified exactly one C++ output. The initial dry-run plan is retained in the artifact directory.

steps: At base_commit, configure normal Clang/GCC targets and prebuild tests, kin_lua and hex_demo. Set TMPDIR to an output filesystem with room. Adjust script paths/affinity for the host. Save entity_scripts.cpp and engine/CMakeLists.txt as before-<basename> plus base-commit in the artifact directory.
Run entity_split_before.py on the original sources to preserve baseline probes and API reports, collect the diagnostic trace and baseline edits. Settle any pending CMake regeneration first.
Run entity_split_transform.py and configure/build the split target. Add the short-key regression to the entity test, then run entity_split_validate.py clang gcc.

Run entity_split_measure.py for mechanical/layout/no-PCH checks, paired runtime/compile measurements, implementation edits and final canonical refresh/smoke/API/no-change checks. No source, header, configuration or Ninja-log changes while compilers run.
Run entity_split_record.py to write the complete record. Keep every sample and the diagnostic trace separate from performance samples.

import json, os, pathlib, shlex, subprocess, sys
from bench_compiler_guard import assert_no_active_compilers

repo = pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time')
base = pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev')
out = base / 'kin-entity-split-bench'
env = {**os.environ, 'TMPDIR': str(out/'tmp'), 'SDL_VIDEODRIVER': 'dummy', 'SDL_AUDIODRIVER': 'dummy'}

def build_dir(compiler='clang'):
    return base / ('kin-build-time-out' if compiler == 'gcc' else 'kin-build-time-clang')

def compile_args(name, obj, compiler='clang', source=None):
    build = build_dir(compiler)
    db = json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text())
    entry = next(e for e in db if e['file'].endswith('/scripting/'+name+'.cpp'))
    args = shlex.split(entry['command'])
    args[args.index('-o')+1] = str(obj)
    if source is not None:
        args[args.index('-c')+1] = str(source)
        args += ['-iquote', str(repo/'engine/src/scripting')]
    return args

def run(args, label, cwd=None, cpus=None, timed=False):
    command = (['taskset', '-c', cpus] if cpus else []) + list(map(str,args))
    if timed:
        command = ['/usr/bin/time', '-f', '{"wall_seconds":%e,"user_seconds":%U,"system_seconds":%S,"max_child_rss_kib":%M}', '-o', str(out/(label+'.stats.json'))] + command
    with (out/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if result.returncode:
        print((out/(label+'.log')).read_text()[-8000:], flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError((label,result.returncode))
    return json.loads((out/(label+'.stats.json')).read_text()) if timed else None

def save(name,value):
    (out/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')

def edit_samples(phase, name='entity_scripts', count=3):
    import re, shutil
    assert_no_active_compilers()
    build=build_dir(); source=repo/('engine/src/scripting/'+name+'.cpp')
    original=source.read_bytes(); stat=source.stat(); rows=[]
    manifest=out/(phase+'-'+name+'-edit.ninja')
    shutil.copy2(build/'build.ninja',manifest)
    clean=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-f',str(manifest),'-n','hex_demo'],env=env,text=True)
    assert 'Building C' not in clean and 'Linking C' not in clean, clean
    try:
        for sample in range(count):
            assert_no_active_compilers()
            source.write_bytes(original+f'\n// Entity implementation edit probe {phase} {sample}.\n'.encode())
            label=f'{phase}-{name}-edit-{sample}'
            plan=subprocess.check_output(['ninja','-C',str(build),'-f',str(manifest),'-n','hex_demo'],env=env,text=True)
            (out/(label+'-plan.log')).write_text(plan)
            planned=re.findall(r'Building CXX object ([^\n]+)',plan)
            assert planned==['engine/CMakeFiles/kin_scripting_scenes.dir/src/scripting/'+name+'.cpp.o'],planned
            load=os.getloadavg()
            stats=run(['ninja','-C',build,'-j4','hex_demo'],label,cpus='0,2,4,6',timed=True)
            actual=re.findall(r'Building CXX object ([^\n]+)',(out/(label+'.log')).read_text())
            assert actual==planned
            row={'phase':phase,'source':str(source.relative_to(repo)),'sample':sample,'planned_and_actual_cpp_outputs':actual,'load_before':load,'load_after':os.getloadavg(),**stats}
            rows.append(row); save(phase+'-'+name+'-edits',rows); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
            source.write_bytes(original);os.utime(source,ns=(stat.st_atime_ns,stat.st_mtime_ns))
    finally:
        source.write_bytes(original);os.utime(source,ns=(stat.st_atime_ns,stat.st_mtime_ns))
    return rows

import concurrent.futures, time
from entity_split_common import *

assert_no_active_compilers()
def no_pch(args):
    result=[];i=0
    while i<len(args):
        if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
        if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
        if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
        if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
        result.append(args[i]);i+=1
    return result

if __name__=='__main__':
    run(['cmake','-S','/tmp/kin-build-time','-B',base/'kin-build-time-3d-clang','-DKIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING=OFF','-DKIN_COMPILER_CACHE=off','-DKIN_ENABLE_PCH=ON','-DKIN_ENABLE_LTO=OFF'],'3d-configure')
    tasks=[]
    header=out/'private-header.cpp';header.write_text('#include "entity_scripts_internal.hpp"\n')
    for mode,compiler,build in [('clang-3d','clang',base/'kin-build-time-3d-clang'),('gcc-no-physics-audio','gcc',build_dir('gcc'))]:
        db=json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text())
        for name in ['entity_scripts','entity_script_bindings','entity_service_bindings','private-header']:
            entry=next(e for e in db if e['file'].endswith('/scripting/'+('entity_scripts' if name=='private-header' else name)+'.cpp'))
            args=no_pch(shlex.split(entry['command']))
            if mode=='gcc-no-physics-audio':
                args=[a for a in args if a.split('=')[0] not in ['-DKIN_ENABLE_PHYSICS','-DKIN_ENABLE_AUDIO']]+['-UKIN_ENABLE_PHYSICS','-UKIN_ENABLE_AUDIO']
            if name=='private-header':args=[str(header) if a==entry['file'] else a for a in args]+['-iquote',str(repo/'engine/src/scripting')]
            tasks.append((mode,name,build,args+['-fsyntax-only']))
    def check(task):
        mode,name,build,args=task;start=time.monotonic()
        run(args,'syntax-'+mode+'-'+name,cwd=build)
        return {'mode':mode,'source':name,'pch':False,'exit_code':0,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start}
    rows=[]
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        for row in pool.map(check,tasks):rows.append(row);save('syntax-results',rows);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
